ups_type.description: UPS connection type. Common values: 'usb', 'snmp', 'net', 'custom'. Choose based on your UPS hardware and connection.

device.description: Device path or network endpoint. Examples: /dev/ttyS0 (serial), /dev/usb/hiddev0 (USB), hostname:port (SNMP).

nis_ip.description: IP address the NIS server will bind to. Use '127.0.0.1' for local only, '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

nis_port.description: Port for the Network Information Server (NIS) — used by monitoring clients like apcaccess.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from the UPS before timing out.

on_battery_delay.description: Delay (in minutes) after power failure before initiating automatic shutdown.

battery_level.description: Minimum battery charge (%) that triggers shutdown. Lower values extend runtime but risk data loss.

minutes.description: Minimum remaining runtime (in minutes) before forced shutdown — overrides battery level if reached first.

kill_on_hibernate.description: If true, the UPS will power off completely after shutdown (only supported on certain models).

hibernate.description: If true, allows the UPS to enter low-power hibernation mode when idle.

web_access.description: Enable the built-in web server for viewing UPS status via a browser.

web_hosts.description: List of IP addresses, hostnames, or CIDR subnets allowed to access the web interface.

web_port.description: TCP port for the web interface (CGI server).

cgi_path.description: Filesystem path to the CGI scripts (typically installed with apcupsd-cgi package).

net_server.description: Enable the network server (required if using apcupsd over the network, e.g., with NIS).

email_addresses.description: List of email addresses to notify during power events (if email_log is enabled).

items.description: Email address to receive UPS alerts

email_log.description: If true, send email notifications on power events (e.g., onbatteries, offbatteries).

syslog.description: Syslog facility for logging. Common values: 'daemon', 'local0'–'local7'.

poll_time.description: Seconds between status polls to the UPS. Lower values give more responsive status but increase load.

snmp_sn.description: SNMP system name (if ups_type is 'snmp'). Usually matches the UPS model or hostname.

snmp_community.description: SNMP community string for read-only access.

lockfile.description: Path to lockfile to prevent multiple apcupsd instances from running.
